summary: Explains selecting tags at runtime and the five options: --tags all (default), --tags tag1,tag2, --skip-tags, --tags tagged, --tags untagged, with examples including running never-tagged tasks and combining --tags with --skip-tags.
questions: How do I run only tasks with certain tags?
How do I skip tasks with a tag?
How do I run everything including never-tagged tasks?
How do I run only untagged tasks?

answer_card.title: Selecting or skipping tags at runtime
answer_card.answer_md:
- `--tags all`: everything except `never` (default)
- `--tags tag1,tag2`: only those tags (plus `always`)
- `--skip-tags tag3,tag4`: everything except those (and `never`)
- `--tags tagged`: tasks with at least one tag
- `--tags untagged`: tasks with no tags (`always` still runs)

```bash
ansible-playbook example.yml --tags "configuration,packages"
ansible-playbook example.yml --skip-tags "packages"
ansible-playbook example.yml --tags "all,never"
ansible-playbook example.yml --tags "tag1,tag3" --skip-tags "tag4"
```
